description: Turn a portrait photo into a compliant passport / visa / ID photo for a given document spec (cropping, resizing, background replacement, quality checks). Returns a temporary download URL for the finished JPEG, its pixel/physical size, and any detected quality issues (e.g. ISSUE_EYEGLASSES_NOT_ALLOWED) that may require a retake. Use list_photo_specs or get_photo_spec first if you are unsure of the specCode. The input image must be base64 (data URI prefix allowed), at most ~4 MB decoded, showing one person facing the camera. Without API credentials this is limited to 3 photos per day.

autoFixShoulder.description: Try to automatically fix uneven/cut-off shoulders. Default false.

imageBase64.description: Source portrait as base64 (JPEG/PNG). A 'data:image/jpeg;base64,' prefix is optional.

photoSheetSizes.description: Optional printable sheet sizes in pixels as 'WIDTH*HEIGHT' (e.g. '1800*1200' = 6x4 in at 300 DPI). Returns a sheet URL per size.

specCode.description: Document spec code, e.g. 'us-passport', 'uk-passport', 'schengen-visa'. Specs starting with 'ai-' use AI generation and may be slow.
